g.text: KDLock mutex throughput and TCLock target
a95a9fb: native outer routing, terminal waiters and lazy mutex frames
Peak = highest valid 300 ms window after 300 ms settling; 2 s measured, 48,000 warmup ops/worker; 3 rounds.
Upper panels: median and min–max. Lower panels: best KD / best TCLock within each complete three-arm, three-round phase; reference lines = 90% and parity.
Failed sessions (including required-JIT failures) stay excluded; accepted native/low-contention samples remain. Rechecks are not pooled.
Whole-run throughput and whole-run JIT/delegation shares are reported separately; peak ratios do not establish sustained parity.
Pinned workers; fixed 2.5 GHz; NUMA enabled; private KD provider UBSAN off. Throughput does not establish equal per-worker service.
